page.layout: One printed page, single column of text. Decorative woodcut border at the top. Below it a dedication in italic heading, then a list of names in capitals with roman and italic text. A signature block at the lower right. A library stamp at the lower left (not transcribed). Faint show-through from the reverse page in the background.

main_text.l: Plurimùm Reverendis, Clarissimis, Excellen-
tissimisque Viris,
DN. JOH. HENRICO ZELLERO, SS. Theologiæ Professori prima-
rio, Scholarchæ p.t. Magnifico.
DN. JOH. CASPARO SVICERO, Linguarum principum Professori,
& scriptorum juris communis faciendorum Censori accuratissimo,
Scholæ item Abbatissanæ Intendenti, ac ædilitatis ad Collegium
Carolinum spectantis Administratori fidelissimo.
DN. JOH. HENRICO LAVATERO, Utr. Med. Doctori Experientis-
simo, Archiatro dexterrimo, Physices ac Matheseos Professori
acutissimo.
DN. JOH. HENRICO HEIDEGGERO, SS. Theologiæ Doctori &
ejusdem Professori eruditissimo, Scholæ Carolinæ Intendenti
dignissimo.
DN. JOHANNI LAVATERO, Logicæ ac Meraphysicæ Professori so-
lidissimo.
DN. JOHANNI MYLLERO, Templi Carolini Archidiacono zelo di-
vinæ gloriæ flagrantissimo, Historiæ Ecclesiasticæ antehac Pro-
fessori nunquam sine veneratione memorando.
DN. JOH. RODOLPHO HOFFMEISTERO, SS. Literarum scruta-
tori indefesso, & earundem Professori solertissimo.
DN. JOH. HENRICO OTTIO, Eloquentiæ & Historiæ Ecclesiasticæ
Professori meritissimo.

l.i: in debiti obsequii ac observantiæ πεχμήριον,

main_text.l: JOH. CASPARUS BRUNNERUS,
Autor & Respondens.

page.notes: Woodcut border at top is decorative. Library stamp "STADT-BIBLIOTHEK ZUERICH" at lower left omitted. Show-through text from the reverse page omitted. Bold/italic and Greek word "πεχμήριον" as printed (likely "τεκμήριον" in print; kept as shown). Several capitalised abbreviations (DN., SS.) rendered as printed.
